reason: A DSH Web sidebar plugin that structures the current conversation by turn, generates concise LLM titles, and lets users jump to corresponding messages.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏按轮次展示当前会话、生成简短标题，并支持点击跳转到对应消息。
summaries.en: A DSH Web sidebar plugin that organizes the current conversation by turn, generates concise titles, and supports navigation to corresponding messages.

capabilities: Reads the current session log to build a structured conversation outline
Displays grouped conversation turns and provides navigation to corresponding messages
Sends visible user and assistant text from turns to the configured model route to generate one-line titles
Stores generated-title caches and settings in browser storage
